title: DISAPPOINTMENT is the understatement
text: DISAPPOINTMENT is the understatement. Finally got these out of the package now that I have all the other stuff to go with them... DISAPPOINTMENT is the understatement.. all they did was cut a pine 2x10 into not 24" but 23 1'8" lengths.. so if your wall is 24" OC and you want to use the studs in the wall for the really nice wall bracket and the hardware that comes with it... prepare for disappointment number two.  the third let down is the actual stain on the wood.. I asked for the dark and that is not even close to what I got.. I got one application of wipe on stain and its splotchy as well... Really?

product_metadata.title: Industrial Shelves w/Metal Brackets (Set of 2) - del Hutson Designs, USA Handmade, Pine Wood (24 Inch / 2 Ft, Dark Walnut)
